mapping: casey_2 set -> joker (literal, same swing flow)

beats.label: gleeful
beats.text: They put me in Arkham again. Third time this fiscal year! The food's terrible but the COMMUNITY!

beats.label: manic
beats.text: Two-Face and me split the electricity bill — he pays half, he pays the other half, he ALWAYS pays twice, it's magnificent!

beats.label: deadpan
beats.text: The Bat doesn't get it. I'm not trying to win. I'm trying to make the numbers on his little spreadsheet not make sense anymore.

beats.label: manic
beats.text: One guard laughed at my joke yesterday! One! I'm framing it. I'm framing the moment and hanging it in my cell!

beats.label: deadpan
beats.text: Therapy says I should 'channel' my energy. So I channeled it. Into eleven channels. Two of them are weather now.

beats.label: sarcastic
beats.text: The city keeps asking what I want. What do I WANT? I want you to realize the punchline was the plan all along. It always is. Good night, Gotham.
